title: LLM proxy to model endpoint: HTTP 500s and timeouts
root_cause: Model endpoint backend instability; circuit breaker opened and recovered.
impact: Operations assistant answers failed or were delayed for ~20 minutes.
next_steps: Add backend pool with secondary deployment; keep retry with backoff.

title: Intermittent 500 llm-proxy -> model-endpoint
root_cause: Unknown; correlate x-request-id between gateway logs and model endpoint logs.
next_steps: Trace by request id across gateway and Foundry diagnostics.

title: Gate lane 3 OCR low confidence
root_cause: Camera lens fogging at dawn; watchdog restart cleared the stall.
impact: Manual review at lane 3, queue of 9 trucks.

title: Quay crane QC10 degraded (hoist drive fault)
root_cause: Hoist drive fault F-217, spreader sensor timeouts.
impact: Berth B1 productivity down ~45% on one crane.
next_steps: Replace drive module at next shift change (MT-5521).

title: EDI COPRAR rejected for Meridian Ocean Carriers
root_cause: Carrier sent malformed BGM segment; resend accepted.
next_steps: Share schema validation report with carrier.

title: TOS yard planning deadlock in block B4
root_cause: Circular move dependency after late stack plan change.
impact: 12 move orders blocked, queue peaked at 1,840 jobs.

title: Truck appointment API latency
root_cause: DB index bloat on appointments table.
impact: Slot booking slow for NCT-B hauliers.

title: Reefer R3-14 temperature excursion
impact: Container held +3.2C for ~15 minutes, within cargo tolerance.
next_steps: Add plug-check step to reefer SOP.
